story_overview: After landing at a jungle outpost secured by soldiers Ryker and Javier, civilian Marco watches as Donovan and Karim arrive by helicopter. Karim leads a group including Ryker, Mateo, and Donovan on a patrol through the burning jungle, where they discover a gruesome pile of fallen soldiers. Back at the camp, tensions rise as Corbin confronts Marco.

video_prompts:
Marco: Man with a mustache and a white collared shirt.
Ryker: Soldier with a full jungle camouflage uniform, a green tactical vest, a green cap, and aviator sunglasses.
The Jungle Outpost: A jungle camp in a grassy clearing with various wooden structures, surrounded by dense green foliage.

Wide shot of The Jungle Outpost, where the green military helicopter is landed in the grassy clearing with its rotors actively spinning. In the foreground, Ryker kneels, aiming the matte black assault rifle outward to provide security. Marco stands nearby, watching the helicopter.

Medium shot in The Jungle Outpost. Ryker, wearing the jungle camouflage uniform, walks across the grassy clearing toward the green military helicopter, which is landed with its rotors spinning. Carrying the matte black assault rifle, Ryker reaches the side of the helicopter and places a hand on the door.

Donovan: Older man with white hair
Corbin: Man in a black military-style uniform and a black beret

In the grassy clearing of The Jungle Outpost, Marco stands watching them, his expression tense. In the foreground, Ryker, wearing the jungle camouflage uniform, kneels on the grass, slowly sweeping the matte black assault rifle across the area. In the background, Donovan and Corbin speak quietly to each other beside the green military helicopter.

Karim: Man with a balding head and a full beard, wearing sunglasses, a light green button-down shirt, and a patterned scarf or keffiyeh.
Javier: Man with short-cropped dark hair, a solid green military-style uniform, a green tactical vest, and a black webbing harness
In The Jungle Outpost, Karim, Donovan, and Javier disembark from the green military helicopter, which has landed in the grassy clearing. Karim, wearing the patterned keffiyeh scarf, steps out first with a smile. Donovan follows him, also smiling, as Javier, wearing the empty tactical vest, exits the helicopter behind them.
